concept.title: Concordance Plot Tool
concept.shortdesc: The Concordance Plot tool provides a visualization of Concordance search results within AntConc.

conbody.p: The Concordance Plot tool graphically represents the results of the standard Concordance tool. Rather than appearing as words, the search terms display as verticle representations of KWIC lines within a rectangle "barcode" graphic that represents complete text of a corpus file.

Depending on the frequency of the search term, the viewability of hits within the graphic may decrease. In that case, AntConc allows you to zoom in to view individual lines. If you click a line, you can view the corresponding instance of the term in the corpus.
